project_name: n8n Real Estate Valuation AI (Gayrimenkul Değerleme Uzmanlığı)
app_type: B2B SaaS AI Chat & Document Generator
theme: Light mode by default (with Dark mode toggle capability). Light mode strongly preferred for document reading and valuation precision.

headings.instruction: Use for all H1-H4. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Banned: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans.
headings.weights: font-light for elegant large headings, font-black for high-impact metric numbers.

body.instruction: Use for all chat messages, document text, and functional UI text. Highly legible for data.

mono.instruction: Use for small data labels, credit balances, and system logs.

colors.philosophy: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action or indicate AI processing.

backgrounds.document_paper: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-zinc-200 dark:ring-zinc-800

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Container layouts should use border-collapse style to expose the skeleton. Divide the sidebar, chat, and document areas with crisp 1px borders (border-r border-border).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for this professional app. Use Flat Solid surfaces to prevent visual refraction of dense document data.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use sharp 1px borders for definition instead of large diffuse shadows.

login_page.left: w-full lg:w-7/12 h-screen relative bg-zinc-950. Use Image [0] with bg-black/40 overlay. Add a massive, typography-driven brand statement.
login_page.right: w-full lg:w-5/12 h-screen flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-12 lg:p-24 bg-white. Google Sign-In button prominent.

dashboard.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 flex flex-col justify-between flex-shrink-0. Contains Chat History, FAQ toggle, and bottom pinned Credit Status/Upsell trigger.
dashboard.main_split: flex-1 flex (Use shadcn ResizablePanelGroup for dynamic sizing).
dashboard.chat_panel: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-[300px] border-r border-zinc-200 bg-white. Scrollable message list + pinned bottom input area with file upload (PDF/XLSX/DOCX).
dashboard.document_preview_panel: flex-1 bg-zinc-100/50 flex flex-col min-w-[300px]. Top sticky header with 'Download' and 'Email' actions. Content area centers a 'physical A4 paper' styled div.

component_instructions.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn components. No native inputs. Squared or slightly rounded (max rounded-md) borders.
component_instructions.buttons: Shadcn buttons. Crisp edges (rounded-md). High contrast focus states.
component_instructions.toasts: Use 'sonner' for credit deductions, error handling, and email dispatch confirmations.
component_instructions.resizable_panels: MANDATORY: Use Shadcn `Resizable` (react-resizable-panels) for the main split between Chat and Document Preview.
component_instructions.modals: Use Shadcn `Dialog` for the 'Low Credit Upsell' and 'Select Report Template' flows.

features_flow.template_selector: On new chat, show a Bento-grid of Report Templates (e.g., Konut, Ticari, Arsa) fetched conceptually from the Knowledge Base.
features_flow.chat_interface: Claude-style interface. AI asks questions sequentially. User uploads PDFs/Excels, AI analyzes and populates the document.
features_flow.live_document: The right panel updates in real-time as the chat progresses. Highlight newly added sections in the document briefly.
features_flow.credit_system: Persistent badge in sidebar. Deduct dynamically. If balance drops to 0, trigger a non-dismissible Dialog for Upsell.

icons.usage: Use sharp, professional icons. Avoid emoji.

login_hero.description: Black and white modern building facade. Use as full-height background for the left side of the login page.

document_empty_state.description: White printing paper with numbers. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background or illustration in the Document Preview panel before a report is generated.

report_blueprint_header.description: Architectural blueprints. Can be used as a branded header image inside the generated report preview.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: No centered layouts for standard content. Left-align text, labels, and forms for rapid readability.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='upload-document-button', data-testid='upsell-modal-trigger').
Use 2-3x more padding than usual. Even dense data grids need breathing room.
Never use generic transition: all. Use specific transition-colors, transition-transform.
Ensure high contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
For the file upload zone, implement a dashed border with a subtle drag-and-drop hover state.
Implement the UI entirely in Turkish as requested by the user, but keep internal variable names and test IDs in English.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over any backgrounds meets APCA standards. Do not use pure grey, tint greys slightly if needed, but strict monochrome works best here.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs must have visible focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-950 focus:ring-offset-2).
